name: Tibial Plateau Fracture
definition: Intra-articular fracture of the proximal tibia involving the knee joint, with risk of soft-tissue injury and compartment syndrome.

investigations.principle: CT helps define depression/splitting and surgical anatomy; MRI is selective for ligament/meniscal injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Fixation depends on displacement, instability and soft-tissue status.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-bhagna principles may complement rehabilitation after stability planning.

patientEducation.summary: Intra-articular fracture of the proximal tibia involving the knee joint, with risk of soft-tissue injury and compartment syndrome.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
